notes: Authoritative record spec for the Imperial active-patron pilot. PROGRESSION CURRENCY = real piety faucet; GATE TYPE = offer / active-patron (IsFirstTierRaceRewardEligible: patron piety Tier >= threshold AND active patron). NO substrate. TARGET PACE: assume ~2 qualifying civic signals/day, each a small piety delta, yielding ~12 days cold-start to Devoted at steady honest civic play (Nord-comparable); Talos faithful-defiance acts are rarer/costlier and do not accelerate the broad faucet. Broad Nine Divines is one always-on family (Layer 1, capped at T2/Devoted-Faithful); the active focused primary patron is the second always-on family (Layer 2, runs T1/T2/T3). ConcordatStanding (PDV_RepTrack_ConcordatStanding) MODIFIES Talos access/offer-priority/pressure, it is NOT a parallel buff track. Talos favor is faithful defiance only; compliance never grants Talos favor. Talos REUSES the existing PDV_Deity_Talos (create:false). T3 NPC recognition is V1-deferred (see PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md); V1 T3 ships stat/signature effects with Champion Survey text as the recognition surface. Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The civic Survey also reports ConcordatStanding band, public/private Talos pressure tilt, repair gate, active patron, and curse posture. Voiced NPC recognition lines are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families only: broad Nine Divines civic lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + one active focused primary patron set (Layer 2, T1/T2/T3). Broad stays softer than focused. ConcordatStanding modifies access/offer-priority/Talos pressure, it is NOT a third buff track. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Imperial reward ceiling: 'Broad Nine Divines plus one focused primary; ConcordatStanding modifies, not a parallel buff track.' No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

authoringPlan.vehicle: Author with a Phase 20 Imperial Mutagen helper (mirror tools/pdv-phase20-khajiit-author with an --author-rewards mode reading this spec); one backed-up framework-ESP write. Reuse reward-author patterns (EnsureMagicEffect/ConfigureMagicEffect/EnsureSpell/ConfigureSpell/ParseActorValue). NO night-condition wiring (Imperial has no lunar/substrate layer).
authoringPlan.recordCreation: Create 30 net-new SPEL with their MGEFs: broad Civic T1/T2 (2; T1 record fills the EXISTING manager property PDV_Bless_Imperial_Civic_T1, T2 is new) + 8 focused patrons x T1/T2/T3 (24) + Talos T1/T2/T3 (3) + PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Imperial (1). Create 8 SHARED deity QUSTs (Akatosh/Mara/Arkay/Stendarr/Zenithar/Dibella/Julianos/Kynareth) -- Imperial is the OWNER (create:true); Nord/Breton REUSE them later (create:false + add their stance) per PDV_Phase2_DeityRoster_and_ArchitectureRulings.md R4. NO PDV_Deity_NineDivines: the broad Civic lane is a STATE (PATRON_STATE_BROAD), not a deity (R1). Talos REUSES existing PDV_Deity_Talos 03DE87 (do not recreate; reference and ConcordatStanding-filter only).
authoringPlan.deityQuestStructure: MUST mirror an existing deity quest (read e.g. PDV_Deity_Kyne 0120B6 fully first): FormVersion 44, Start-Game-Enabled (SGE) flag, SEQ entry, QuestAdapter VMAD hosting the PDV_Deity_<Name> script with base properties DeityName(String), DeityIndex(Int, assign next-available - clear of the existing low indices and Azura/Khenarthi/Rajhin/Alkosh at 40-43), Stance_Imperial=0(NATIVE), PDV_GLO_OriginRace, PDV_GLO_DebugLevel. Thresholds use script defaults (25/50/85). CRITICAL: every new PDV_Deity_* QUST needs the SGE flag AND a SEQ entry; the EnsureQuest author helper omits SGE (this is how BaanDar shipped broken) - verify SGE+SEQ explicitly.
